name: Shear-warp Factorization for Combined Surface/Volume Rendering
aliases: Fast Surface and Volume Rendering Based on Shear-Warp Factorization
Fast combination of volume-rendered and surface-rendered images
definition: A method for real-time visualization in surgical simulators that combines volume-rendered 3D medical images (organs) with surface-rendered medical instruments (e.g., needles) using shear-warp factorization, Z-buffer depth comparison, early ray termination, and instrument-region masking to reduce computation.
